logger.doc:name: Log Generic Error
logger.message: #[now() >> "Asia/Kolkata" as String ++ ' | ' ++ (vars.batchId default"") ++ ' | Unhandled error in flow ' ++ (vars.flowName default 'unknown') ++ ' | type=' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' | desc=' ++ (error.description default 'Unexpected internal error')]

set-payload.value: #[{ headerLine: "!!! Alert Batch Failed", batch: vars.batchId, success: false, flowName: flow.name default 'unknown', errorCode: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: vars.errorMessage, timestamp: now() as String }]

logger.doc:name: Log DB Error
logger.message: #[now() >> "Asia/Kolkata" as String ++ ' | ' ++ (vars.batchId default"") ++ ' | Database error in flow ' ++ (flow.name default 'unknown') ++ ' | type=' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' | desc=' ++ (error.description default 'Database operation failed')]

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { headerLine: "!!! Alert Database Error", batch: vars.batchId, success: false, flowName: flow.name default 'unknown', errorCode: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: vars.errorMessage, timestamp: now() as String }]

logger.doc:name: Log SFTP Error
logger.message: #[now() >> "Asia/Kolkata" as String ++ ' | ' ++ (vars.batchId default"") ++ ' | SFTP error in flow ' ++ (vars.flowName default 'unknown') ++ ' | type=' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' | desc=' ++ (error.description default 'SFTP operation failed') ++ ' | path=' ++ ((vars.path default '') as String)]

set-payload.value: #[{ headerLine: "!!! Alert SFTP Error", batch: vars.batchId, success: false, flowName: flow.name default 'unknown', errorCode: 'SFTP Error', message: vars.errorMessage, timestamp: now() as String }]

logger.doc:name: Log Email Error
logger.message: #[now() >> "Asia/Kolkata" as String ++ ' | ' ++ (vars.batchId default"") ++ ' | Email error in flow ' ++ (vars.flowName default 'unknown') ++ ' | type=' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' | desc=' ++ (error.description default 'Email sending failed')]

set-payload.value: #[{ headerLine: "!!! Alert EMAIL Error", batch: vars.batchId, success: false, flowName: flow.name default 'unknown', errorCode: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: vars.errorMessage, timestamp: now() as String }]

logger.doc:name: Log Generic Error
logger.message: #[now() >> "Asia/Kolkata" as String ++ ' | ' ++ (vars.batchId default"") ++ ' | Unhandled error in flow ' ++ (vars.flowName default 'unknown') ++ ' | type=' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' | desc=' ++ (error.description default 'Unexpected internal error')]

set-payload.value: #[{ headerLine: "!!! Alert Internal Error", batch: vars.batchId, success: false, flowName: flow.name default 'unknown', errorCode: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: vars.errorMessage, timestamp: now() as String }]
